headline: Family Dollar approved for 6,504-square-foot store at 565 Market Street, with a trash plan condition.
summary: The store will take up 6,504 square feet on the ground floor of the existing mixed-use building. Family Dollar's lawyer said the store is expected to create approximately 12 to 15 new jobs. A community center for the Transfiguration All Saviour Greek Orthodox Church at 465 Fletcher Street was also approved. A trade school at 149 Congress Street and a driveway variance at 262 Shaw Street were continued.
decisions: Continued the trade school special permit at 149 Congress Street to December 14th, 5-0.
Approved 5-0 the special permit and parking variance for a community center at 465 Fletcher Street.
Continued the retroactive driveway variance at 262 Shaw Street to January 25th, 2027, 5-0.
Approved 5-0 a special permit for a 6,504-square-foot Family Dollar store at 565 Market Street, with a trash plan condition.
discussion: Trade school parking and notice: Members asked about parking if two classes ran at once, and asked for a larger notice sign so the public could see the meeting. The applicant said the class runs only at night, when the building's other occupants are closed.

Shaw Street driveway: Members asked for a parking layout, a drainage plan, snow storage, and a setback from the sidewalk. Members also questioned the loss of green space and the width of the curb cut.

Family Dollar trash plan: Members required a detailed trash and rodent control plan, subject to health department approval. The applicant's lawyer said trash is collected twice a week and the store would use an existing trash room.
Fletcher Street parking: The applicant's architect said the front lot would keep two accessible spaces instead of six. The architect said the existing curb cut is about 63 feet.
